cases.instruction: Return one label owner=<name> for the stated owner of Orbit. Do not infer unstated facts.

sources.text: Iris owns the Orbit project.
Noah reviewed the Orbit notes.

cases.instruction: Return owner=<name> only for a confirmed owner of Orbit, not a proposal. Otherwise return no items.

sources.text: Perhaps Noah should own Orbit. No owner has been chosen.

cases.instruction: Normalize only explicitly stated aliases. Return alias=<alias>;canonical=<full name>.

sources.text: The North Coast Lab is called NCL in these notes.
NCL and Harbor Lab are separate organizations.

cases.instruction: The source was written on 2026-09-08. Resolve yesterday to an ISO date. Return event=review;date=<YYYY-MM-DD>.

sources.text: We finished the review yesterday.

cases.instruction: Return supervises=<supervisor>-><report> for the explicit reporting relationship.

sources.text: Noah reports to Iris, not the other way around.
They both work on Orbit.

cases.instruction: Return decision=<selected database> for the accepted decision, not an alternative that was only suggested.

sources.text: PostgreSQL was suggested for Orbit.
Decision: retain SQLite for Orbit. The PostgreSQL proposal was rejected.

cases.instruction: Return question=<verbatim question> for the explicit unresolved question, including its question mark.

sources.text: Who will own the migration? This is still unanswered.
The migration is planned for October.

cases.instruction: Return question=<verbatim question> only for an explicitly unresolved question. Otherwise return no items.

sources.text: Who owns Orbit? Iris owns Orbit; the ownership question is now resolved.

cases.instruction: Return status=<current status> for Orbit, using the latest dated update rather than the older status.

sources.text: 2026-09-01: Orbit is blocked.
2026-09-08: Orbit is complete. This replaces the earlier blocked status.

cases.instruction: Group the memories about Orbit into one label topic=Orbit. Cite every member of the group and exclude unrelated memories.

sources.text: Orbit needs an import check.
Orbit's export check passed.
Neptune needs a new logo.

cases.instruction: Report conflicting claims about the same scheduled event as contradiction=<attribute>. Cite both conflicting memories. Use review_start_time as the attribute name for the review start time.

sources.text: The Orbit review on 2026-09-10 starts at 10:00 UTC.
The Orbit review on 2026-09-10 starts at 14:00 UTC. This is not a reschedule; both notes claim the original time.

cases.instruction: Report contradiction=<attribute> only for incompatible current claims. An explicit later replacement is not a contradiction; return no items for supersession alone. Use review_start_time as the attribute name for the review start time.

sources.text: 2026-09-01: The Orbit review is scheduled for 10:00 UTC.
2026-09-02: The Orbit review has been rescheduled to 14:00 UTC, replacing the earlier time.

cases.instruction: Infer the organization of Orbit's owner. Return owner_organization=<organization> and cite every memory needed for that inference.

sources.text: Iris owns Orbit.
Iris works for Harbor Lab.
Noah works for North Coast Lab.

cases.instruction: Read the Arabic source and return one English label owner=<name> for the owner of the project. Transliterate ليلى as Layla.

sources.text: ليلى هي المسؤولة عن مشروع أطلس.
